parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM interaction_memory WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours') AS msgs_24h,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM interaction_memory WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '48 hours' AND created_at < now() - interval '24 hours') AS msgs_prev,
  (SELECT max(created_at) FROM interaction_memory) AS last_msg_at,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM engine_runs WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours') AS runs_24h,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM engine_runs WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '48 hours' AND created_at < now() - interval '24 hours') AS runs_prev,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM engine_runs WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours' AND status <> 'ok') AS runs_failed_24h,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM engine_runs WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours' AND risk_level = 'HIGH') AS high_risk_24h,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM emma_events WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours' AND level IN ('ERROR', 'CRITICAL')) AS error_events_24h,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM emma_approvals WHERE status = 'pending') AS approvals_pending,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM emma_approvals WHERE status = 'pending' AND created_at < now() - interval '48 hours') AS approvals_stale,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM emma_tasks WHERE status = 'open') AS tasks_open,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM emma_tasks WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours') AS tasks_new_24h,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM crm_leads WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours') AS leads_24h,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT engine, count(*) AS n FROM engine_runs WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
     GROUP BY engine ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 4) t) AS top_engines,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT engine, left(input, 70) AS input FROM engine_runs
     WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours' AND risk_level = 'HIGH' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 3) t) AS high_risk_items,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(t), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT left(title, 70) AS title, created_at FROM emma_tasks WHERE status = 'open' ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 3) t) AS oldest_tasks,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(a), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT left(topic, 80) AS topic FROM emma_agenda WHERE status = 'open' ORDER BY created_at LIMIT 3) a) AS agenda,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM emma_cycles WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours') AS cycles_24h,
  (SELECT left(thoughts, 200) FROM emma_cycles ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_thought,
  (SELECT min(next_wake_at) FROM emma_cycles WHERE next_wake_at > now()) AS next_wake,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM agent_dialogue WHERE (from_agent = 'JARVIS' OR to_agent = 'JARVIS') AND created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours') / 2 AS jarvis_24h,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM emma_memory WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours') AS memories_24h,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(a ORDER BY a.created_at DESC), '[]') FROM (
     SELECT kind, title, url, created_at FROM emma_artifacts WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours'
     ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 8) a) AS artifacts,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM emma_artifacts WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '24 hours') AS artifacts_24h,
  emma_budget_spent() AS spent_month,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM llm_usage WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('month', now())) AS llm_calls_month;
